methodology: Balanced, deterministic selection across cloud/aerosol class, solar-altitude regime, camera direction, and latitude band. Only direction images with CLOUD GAZE agreement >= 0.65 and at least five classifications are admitted. The night corpus additionally admits high/medium-confidence moon-centred inverse-fisheye normalizations from the phase-balanced lunar benchmark.
